test_struct_field_access: test accessing struct fields by name using struct.field() and struct["field"] syntax
test_struct_rename_fields: test renaming struct field names using struct.rename_fields() method
test_struct_json_encode: test encoding struct data to JSON strings using struct.json_encode() method
test_struct_unnest: test flattening struct columns back to DataFrame using struct.unnest() method
test_struct_field_by_index: test accessing struct fields by integer index using struct[0] and struct[-1] syntax
test_struct_map_fields: test renaming struct fields via name.map_fields() with a lambda function
test_struct_prefix_suffix_fields: test prepending and appending prefixes or suffixes to struct field names
test_struct_json_encode_logical_types: test encoding struct fields with logical types like date, datetime, timedelta, decimal, and int128 to JSON
